observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of an engine with pulleys, belts, and metal components. The engine appears used, with visible grime and wear.
Photo 1 shows a wider view of the engine, including the intake manifold, throttle body, and various hoses and sensors. The engine is dirty and appears to be in a workshop or storage area.
Photo 2 shows a side view of the engine block, with the cylinder head and part of the intake manifold visible. The engine block is metallic and shows signs of use.
No brand or model is visible on any part of the engine in any photo.
The seller claims to deal in 'Japanese parts engine and accessories', but no Japanese branding or model identifiers are visible in the photos.
